method: Picked from the artist's own posts in x-posts.json (1,465 distinct prose posts read in full) for what they say about the work, the series, Nifty Ink, burning, process and the artist's views. text is verbatim from x-posts.json. curatorNote is ours, not the artist's. Screenshots are X's public embed widget rendered in a headless browser.
